name: CAT-style

coverage.note: Duration, sectional time and questions per section verified from the official CAT 2024 media release (VARC 24, DILR 22, QA 22; 120 min, 40 per section). The MCQ/TITA split and marking (+3, −1 for MCQ, no negative for TITA) are from Career Launcher's Slot 1 analysis, not an official source, and vary by slot. Verified 29 Oct 2026 against the cited sources.

sections.name: VARC – MCQ

sections.name: VARC – TITA
sections.style: Type in the answer (e.g. odd one out)

sections.name: DILR – MCQ
sections.style: set-based data interpretation and logical reasoning

pattern.notes: 68 questions in 120 minutes with 40 minutes per section (sectional time limit). TITA (type in the answer) has no negative marking.

topics.subject: VARC
topics.name: Para summary / completion / odd one out

topics.subject: DILR
topics.name: DI and LR sets (5 sets of 4–5)

notes: CAT 2024 Slot 1 was rated easier than 2023: VARC easy, DILR easy–moderate, QA moderate (Career Launcher).
No para-jumbles in 2024 VARC; para-completion questions instead.

traps: Sectional timer: unused time does not carry over.
MCQ negative marking (−1) but none for TITA.
Long DILR sets that look easy but take 15+ minutes.
assumptions: MCQ/TITA split per section and the +3/−1 marking come from Career Launcher's CAT 2024 Slot 1 analysis, not from IIM.
